name: The Hammer May Fall
summary: Tallow sends fighters from Tarren Mill across the mountains to relieve Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. Before reporting to Drum Fel, you prove your battle readiness against Boulderfist ogres near the ruins of Stromgarde.

sections.title: A Gruff Summons
sections.body: In Tarren Mill, Tallow has little patience for untested fighters wandering the Foothills. While recruits stand idle, allies are under attack far away. He sends capable fighters east through Thoradin's Wall into the Arathi Highlands, where Hammerfall is besieged from several sides. Tallow wants them to prove their worth against a strong foe before he sends them to the outpost.

sections.title: Trial by Boulderfist
sections.body: Tallow demands a display of strength at the ogre mound northeast of the ruins of Stromgarde. Boulderfist ogres and their enforcers hold much of Arathi, threatening travelers on the highland trails. Fighting them thins the hostile forces flanking the road and proves you can stand against the danger before reaching Hammerfall.

sections.title: Reporting to Hammerfall
sections.body: After the Boulderfist camp is cleared, the road leads northeast to Hammerfall, named for Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer. Commander Drum Fel receives the new arrivals with weary skepticism. Whether Tallow meant to strengthen the garrison or send fools to their deaths, Drum Fel quickly turns proven fighters toward the skirmishes threatening the outpost.

faq.q: Where does this quest begin and end?
aliases: where do i start the hammer may fall
who gives the hammer may fall
faq.answer: Tallow offers this assignment in Tarren Mill, in the Hillsbrad Foothills. After you defeat the required ogres in the Arathi Highlands, you report to Drum Fel at Hammerfall, the Horde outpost.

faq.q: Where are the Boulderfist ogres located?
aliases: where are the ogres in arathi
faq.answer: The Boulderfist ogres live at a prominent dirt mound and camp northeast of the ruins of Stromgarde in the Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: What is the outpost of Hammerfall?
faq.answer: Hammerfall is a fortified Horde settlement in northeastern Arathi Highlands. It honors former Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer, who fell nearby during the liberation of the orc internment camps.

faq.q: Why does Tallow make you fight ogres before reporting to Hammerfall?
faq.answer: Hammerfall is under constant attack and desperate for capable fighters. Tallow sends you against the Boulderfist ogres to prove you can fight before you reinforce Drum Fel, rather than arrive as a burden.
Drum Fel is a veteran orc warrior and commander at Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. He organizes defenses against hostile wildlife, ogres, trolls, and Alliance remnants.
Reporting to Drum Fel leads to the Call to Arms campaign, a series of military operations against surrounding threats, including the Witherbark troll tribes threatening the highlands.

angles.text: This assignment carries you from Hillsbrad's local disputes into the wider defense of the Arathi Highlands, where Hammerfall holds a vital foothold.
As an orc, Hammerfall carries deep meaning and history. It was founded where Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer gave his life during the liberation campaigns.
As a warrior, you face hulking Boulderfist enforcers to prove yourself to veteran orc commanders like Drum Fel.
